correctness.rationale: Any two selected edges admit a different edge intersecting both. For three edges, a matching and a triangle each dominate. If a pair is ab,ac, then a third edge through a gives a star and an external vertex supplies an unselected transversal through a; a third edge not through a either is bc (triangle) or has an endpoint outside {a,b,c}, again supplying a transversal through a. Triangles cannot share two edges with any other optimum. Removing one matching edge frees n−4 vertices for jumping and n−6 previously unmatched vertices for the disjoint replacement used in sliding. With one spare vertex one can free one end of a missing target edge by moving its current edge before installing the target, preserving all installed target edges. At n=8 the omitted pair completes a unique four-pair partition, and slides change only which pair is omitted, giving 8!/(2⁴4!)=105 four-cliques. With three spare vertices, an overlapping jump can use the pair of spare vertices not used by its target as an intermediate slide. These prove the components and degree/edge counts; use the combinatorial zero convention for out-of-range binomial counts, including n=5 where the matching layer is empty. An independent enumeration from closed domination and shared two-edge buckets matched both boundary transitions for n=5 through 9.
residual_risks: Bounded enumeration does not prove the unbounded cases. 'Connected at n=7 or n=9' refers only to the matching layer, not the full exchange graph.

originality.rationale: The jumping connectivity is a special case of prior general fixed-cardinality matching reconfiguration. The whole nontrivial sliding layer is exactly represented by the k=2 reduction of the distinct indexed Roman-function theorem a3f3d09e0ceb, for the same disjoint-replacement move. The triangle isolates and degree/edge formulas left over are immediate from the known minimum-set classification and local counts. This is a decision about checked existing coverage, not a conclusion that the November catalogue finding preceded, was available to, or was derived independently of the October record.
residual_risks: Separate catalogue publication dates do not resolve discovery priority. Different Roman/ordinary domination names alone would miss the identical matching state and move system.
